mapper.insert: insert into tbk_order (platform, order_id, item_id, goods_sign, item_title, item_img, shop_name, pid, user_id, external_user, link_id, match_type, status, status_desc, total_amount, pay_amount, estimated_commission, settled_commission, cashback_rate, cashback_amount, cashback_status, commission_rate, pay_time, settle_time, refund_tag, raw_data, create_time, update_time) values (#{platform}, #{orderId}, #{itemId}, #{goodsSign}, #{itemTitle}, #{itemImg}, #{shopName}, #{pid}, #{userId}, #{externalUser}, #{linkId}, #{matchType}, #{status}, #{statusDesc}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{estimatedCommission}, #{settledCommission}, #{cashbackRate}, #{cashbackAmount}, #{cashbackStatus}, #{commissionRate}, #{payTime}, #{settleTime}, #{refundTag}, #{rawData}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update item_id = values(item_id), goods_sign = coalesce(values(goods_sign), goods_sign), item_title = values(item_title), item_img = values(item_img), shop_name = values(shop_name), pid = values(pid), user_id = coalesce(values(user_id), user_id), external_user = coalesce(values(external_user), external_user), link_id = coalesce(values(link_id), link_id), match_type = coalesce(values(match_type), match_type), status = values(status), status_desc = values(status_desc), total_amount = values(total_amount), pay_amount = values(pay_amount), estimated_commission = values(estimated_commission), settled_commission = values(settled_commission), cashback_rate = values(cashback_rate), cashback_amount = values(cashback_amount), cashback_status = values(cashback_status), commission_rate = values(commission_rate), pay_time = values(pay_time), settle_time = values(settle_time), refund_tag = values(refund_tag), raw_data = values(raw_data), update_time = now()
mapper.select:
select o.id, o.platform, o.order_id, o.item_id, o.goods_sign, o.item_title, o.item_img, o.shop_name, o.pid, o.user_id, u.user_name, o.external_user, o.link_id, o.match_type, o.status, o.status_desc, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, o.estimated_commission, o.settled_commission, o.cashback_rate, o.cashback_amount, o.cashback_status, o.commission_rate, o.pay_time, o.settle_time, o.refund_tag, o.create_time, o.update_time from tbk_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.user_id
order by o.pay_time desc, o.id desc

select count(*) as totalCount, coalesce(sum(coalesce(nullif(o.settled_commission, 0), o.estimated_commission, 0)), 0) as totalCommission, coalesce(sum(o.cashback_amount), 0) as totalCashback, coalesce(sum(case when date(o.pay_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayCount, coalesce(sum(case when date(o.pay_time) = curdate() then coalesce(nullif(o.settled_commission, 0), o.estimated_commission, 0) else 0 end), 0) as todayCommission, coalesce(sum(case when date(o.pay_time) = curdate() then o.cashback_amount else 0 end), 0) as todayCashback, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as monthCount, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m') then coalesce(nullif(o.settled_commission, 0), o.estimated_commission, 0) else 0 end), 0) as monthCommission, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m') then o.cashback_amount else 0 end), 0) as monthCashback from tbk_order o

select o.platform, count(*) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(coalesce(nullif(o.settled_commission, 0), o.estimated_commission, 0)), 0) as commission from tbk_order o
group by o.platform order by commission desc
